limitations: Two intervention guests and five add calls each; not a full trajectory or performance estimate
Initial inspection warms metadata; first add warms contents; default DAMON may evict during trials; no guaranteed warm cache
Git --refresh preserves paths/modes/content objects/stages; index metadata and optional extensions can change; not a single-stat-field intervention
Complete per-file lstat rows retained; full stat aggregates recomputed; this does not identify individual fields causing Git work or where image metadata changed
Guest device-wide block counters are not process-owned bytes or host physical I/O; native timers may nest and omit work
Probe overhead was not calibrated for natural replay; CPU policy requests do not guarantee exclusive or strictly fixed-frequency CPUs
